from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP

# ==========================================
# CONSTANTS SECTION (Tax Laws FY 2025-26)
# ==========================================

# Sec 16(ia) - Standard deduction amounts
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal("50000")  # Sec 16(ia)
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal("75000")  # Sec 16(ia) read with Sec 115BAC

# Sec 24(b) - Self-occupied house property interest cap (old regime only)
SOH_INTEREST_CAP = Decimal("200000")  # Sec 24(b)

# Sec 80C - Maximum deduction (old regime only)
SEC_80C_CAP = Decimal("150000")  # Sec 80C & Sec 80CCE

# Sec 80CCD(1B) - Additional NPS contribution cap (old regime only)
SEC_80CCD_1B_CAP = Decimal("50000")  # Sec 80CCD(1B)

# Sec 80D - Health insurance caps (old regime only)
SEC_80D_SELF_REGULAR = Decimal("25000")  # Sec 80D(1)(i)
SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")  # Sec 80D(1)(i) proviso
SEC_80D_PARENTS_REGULAR = Decimal("25000")  # Sec 80D(1)(ii)
SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")  # Sec 80D(1)(ii) proviso

# First Schedule, Part III, Para A — Old regime income tax slabs (lower, upper, rate)
SLABS_OLD_BELOW_60 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("250000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("250000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

SLABS_OLD_60_80 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("300000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

SLABS_OLD_80_PLUS = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

# Sec 115BAC — New tax regime slabs (same for all ages)
SLABS_NEW = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("400000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("400000"), Decimal("800000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("800000"), Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("1600000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("1600000"), Decimal("2000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("2000000"), Decimal("2400000"), Decimal("0.25")),
    (Decimal("2400000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

# Sec 87A — Rebate thresholds and limits
REBATE_LIMIT_OLD = Decimal("500000")  # Sec 87A (old)
REBATE_CAP_OLD = Decimal("12500")  # Sec 87A (old)
REBATE_LIMIT_NEW = Decimal("1200000")  # Sec 87A (new)
REBATE_CAP_NEW = Decimal("60000")  # Sec 87A (new)

# First Schedule — Surcharge thresholds and rates (Old regime)
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_OLD = [
    (Decimal("5000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("10000000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("20000000"), Decimal("0.25")),
    (Decimal("50000000"), Decimal("0.37")),
]

# First Schedule — Surcharge thresholds and rates (New regime capped at 25%)
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_NEW = [
    (Decimal("5000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("10000000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("20000000"), Decimal("0.25")),
]

# Health and Education Cess rate
CESS_RATE = Decimal("0.04")  # Health and Education Cess


def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> tuple[Decimal, Decimal]:
    """
    Sec 288A / Sec 288B:
    Paise are ignored (floor to whole rupees), then rounded to the nearest multiple of 10.
    Returns (rounded_amount, adjustment_amount).
    """
    floored = amount.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
    # Nearest multiple of 10: last digit >= 5 rounds up
    rem = floored % Decimal("10")
    if rem >= Decimal("5"):
        rounded = floored + (Decimal("10") - rem)
    else:
        rounded = floored - rem
    adjustment = rounded - amount
    return rounded, adjustment


def compute_regime(inp: dict, is_new: bool) -> dict:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp["gross_salary"]))
    age = int(inp["age"])
    trace = []

    # 1. Salary & Exemptions / Deductions
    trace.append(
        {
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Gross salary",
            "amount": str(gross_salary),
            "clause": "Sec 17(1)",
        }
    )

    current_income = gross_salary

    if not is_new:
        # HRA Exemption (Old regime only)
        hra_received = Decimal(str(inp["hra_received"]))
        basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp["basic_plus_da"]))
        rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp["rent_paid"]))
        rent_city_is_metro = bool(inp["rent_city_is_metro"])

        if hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
            # rent in excess of 10% of salary
            rent_excess = rent_paid - (basic_plus_da * Decimal("0.10"))
            if rent_excess < Decimal("0"):
                rent_excess = Decimal("0")

            # 50% or 40% of salary
            percentage = Decimal("0.50") if rent_city_is_metro else Decimal("0.40")
            pct_salary = basic_plus_da * percentage

            hra_exempt = min(hra_received, rent_excess, pct_salary)
            if hra_exempt < Decimal("0"):
                hra_exempt = Decimal("0")
        else:
            hra_exempt = Decimal("0")

        if hra_exempt > Decimal("0"):
            trace.append(
                {
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "House rent allowance exemption",
                    "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
                    "clause": "Sec 10(13A) read with Rule 2A",
                }
            )
            current_income -= hra_exempt

        # Standard Deduction (Old)
        std_ded = min(STD_DEDUCTION_OLD, current_income)
        trace.append(
            {
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Standard deduction",
                "amount": str(-std_ded),
                "clause": "Sec 16(ia)",
            }
        )
        current_income -= std_ded

        # House Property Loss (Old regime)
        home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp["home_loan_interest"]))
        hp_interest_deduction = min(home_loan_interest, SOH_INTEREST_CAP)
        if hp_interest_deduction > Decimal("0"):
            trace.append(
                {
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "Loss from self-occupied house property set off",
                    "amount": str(-hp_interest_deduction),
                    "clause": "Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)",
                }
            )
            current_income -= hp_interest_deduction

    else:
        # Standard Deduction (New)
        std_ded = min(STD_DEDUCTION_NEW, current_income)
        trace.append(
            {
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Standard deduction",
                "amount": str(-std_ded),
                "clause": "Sec 16(ia) read with Sec 115BAC",
            }
        )
        current_income -= std_ded

    gross_total_income = max(current_income, Decimal("0"))

    # Chapter VI-A Deductions (Old regime only)
    chapter_via_total = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new:
        sec_80c = min(Decimal(str(inp["sec_80c"])), SEC_80C_CAP)
        if sec_80c > Decimal("0"):
            trace.append(
                {
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "Deduction for life insurance, PF, PPF, etc.",
                    "amount": str(-sec_80c),
                    "clause": "Sec 80C",
                }
            )
            chapter_via_total += sec_80c

        sec_80ccd_1b = min(Decimal(str(inp["sec_80ccd_1b"])), SEC_80CCD_1B_CAP)
        if sec_80ccd_1b > Decimal("0"):
            trace.append(
                {
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "Additional deduction for NPS contribution",
                    "amount": str(-sec_80ccd_1b),
                    "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)",
                }
            )
            chapter_via_total += sec_80ccd_1b

        # Sec 80D Health Insurance
        health_ins_self = Decimal(str(inp["health_ins_self"]))
        health_ins_parents = Decimal(str(inp["health_ins_parents"]))
        parents_senior = bool(inp["parents_senior"])

        self_cap = (
            SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR
            if (age >= 60 or inp.get("spouse_senior", False))
            else SEC_80D_SELF_REGULAR
        )
        parents_cap = (
            SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR if parents_senior else SEC_80D_PARENTS_REGULAR
        )

        ded_80d_self = min(health_ins_self, self_cap)
        ded_80d_parents = min(health_ins_parents, parents_cap)
        ded_80d = ded_80d_self + ded_80d_parents

        if ded_80d > Decimal("0"):
            trace.append(
                {
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "Deduction for health insurance premium",
                    "amount": str(-ded_80d),
                    "clause": "Sec 80D",
                }
            )
            chapter_via_total += ded_80d

        # Sec 80A(2) Overall cap: Chapter VI-A cannot exceed gross total income
        if chapter_via_total > gross_total_income:
            excess_via = chapter_via_total - gross_total_income
            # Adjust trace or just cap total income
            chapter_via_total = gross_total_income

    total_income_unrounded = max(gross_total_income - chapter_via_total, Decimal("0"))

    # Sec 288A Rounding of total income
    total_income, income_rounding_adj = round_nearest_ten(total_income_unrounded)
    if income_rounding_adj != Decimal("0"):
        trace.append(
            {
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Rounding adjustment to total income",
                "amount": str(income_rounding_adj),
                "clause": "Sec 288A",
            }
        )

    # 2. Tax Computation
    if is_new:
        slabs = SLABS_NEW
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_80_PLUS
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_60_80
        else:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_BELOW_60

    # Calculate slab-wise tax and emit one line per band
    tax_before_rebate = Decimal("0")
    for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
        if total_income <= lower:
            continue
        upper_bound = upper if upper is not None else total_income
        taxable_in_slab = min(total_income, upper_bound) - lower
        if taxable_in_slab > Decimal("0"):
            slab_tax = taxable_in_slab * rate
            tax_before_rebate += slab_tax
            # Format description for slab
            if upper is not None:
                desc = f"Tax on income slab {int(lower)+1:,} to {int(upper):,} at {int(rate*100)}%"
            else:
                desc = f"Tax on income slab above {int(lower):,} at {int(rate*100)}%"
            trace.append(
                {
                    "kind": "tax",
                    "description": desc,
                    "amount": str(slab_tax),
                    "clause": "First Schedule, Part III, Para A",
                }
            )

    # Sec 87A Rebate
    rebate = Decimal("0")
    if is_new:
        if total_income <= REBATE_LIMIT_NEW:
            rebate = min(tax_before_rebate, REBATE_CAP_NEW)
        else:
            # Marginal relief (new regime only):
            # where total income exceeds 12,00,000 and tax payable exceeds (total income - 12,00,000)
            excess_income = total_income - REBATE_LIMIT_NEW
            if tax_before_rebate > excess_income:
                marginal_rebate = tax_before_rebate - excess_income
                rebate = marginal_rebate
    else:
        if total_income <= REBATE_LIMIT_OLD:
            rebate = min(tax_before_rebate, REBATE_CAP_OLD)

    tax_after_rebate = max(tax_before_rebate - rebate, Decimal("0"))
    if rebate > Decimal("0"):
        trace.append(
            {
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": "Rebate",
                "amount": str(-rebate),
                "clause": "Sec 87A",
            }
        )

    # Surcharge and Surcharge Marginal Relief
    surcharge_thresholds = (
        SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_NEW if is_new else SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_OLD
    )
    applicable_surcharge_rate = Decimal("0")
    surcharge_threshold = Decimal("0")
    for thresh, rate in surcharge_thresholds:
        if total_income > thresh:
            applicable_surcharge_rate = rate
            surcharge_threshold = thresh

    surcharge = tax_after_rebate * applicable_surcharge_rate

    if surcharge > Decimal("0"):
        trace.append(
            {
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": f"Surcharge at {int(applicable_surcharge_rate*100)}%",
                "amount": str(surcharge),
                "clause": "First Schedule",
            }
        )

        # Surcharge Marginal Relief
        # Tax + Surcharge on actual income should not exceed Tax + Surcharge on threshold + (total_income - threshold)
        # Compute tax at threshold
        thresh_tax_before_rebate = Decimal("0")
        for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
            if surcharge_threshold <= lower:
                continue
            upper_bound = upper if upper is not None else surcharge_threshold
            taxable_in_slab = min(surcharge_threshold, upper_bound) - lower
            if taxable_in_slab > Decimal("0"):
                thresh_tax_before_rebate += taxable_in_slab * rate

        # Threshold has no rebate generally since threshold > rebate limits (50L / 12L > 5L/12L)
        thresh_tax_after_rebate = thresh_tax_before_rebate
        # Surcharge at threshold
        thresh_surcharge = thresh_tax_after_rebate * applicable_surcharge_rate
        max_allowed_tax_surcharge = (
            thresh_tax_after_rebate + thresh_surcharge + (total_income - surcharge_threshold)
        )

        actual_tax_surcharge = tax_after_rebate + surcharge
        if actual_tax_surcharge > max_allowed_tax_surcharge:
            surcharge_relief = actual_tax_surcharge - max_allowed_tax_surcharge
            surcharge -= surcharge_relief
            trace.append(
                {
                    "kind": "tax",
                    "description": "Surcharge marginal relief",
                    "amount": str(-surcharge_relief),
                    "clause": "First Schedule",
                }
            )

    tax_plus_surcharge = tax_after_rebate + surcharge

    # Health and Education Cess
    cess = tax_plus_surcharge * CESS_RATE
    if cess > Decimal("0"):
        trace.append(
            {
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": "Health and Education Cess at 4%",
                "amount": str(cess),
                "clause": "Finance Act / Income-tax Act",
            }
        )

    tax_payable_unrounded = tax_plus_surcharge + cess

    # Sec 288B Rounding of tax payable
    tax_payable, tax_rounding_adj = round_nearest_ten(tax_payable_unrounded)
    if tax_rounding_adj != Decimal("0"):
        trace.append(
            {
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": "Rounding adjustment to tax payable",
                "amount": str(tax_rounding_adj),
                "clause": "Sec 288B",
            }
        )

    return {
        "total_income": int(total_income),
        "tax_payable": int(tax_payable),
        "trace": trace,
    }


def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    old_res = compute_regime(inp, is_new=False)
    new_res = compute_regime(inp, is_new=True)
    return {"old": old_res, "new": new_res}
